facts.claim: Income Certificate in Gujarat is applied for through the Digital Gujarat citizen services portal.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Visit: https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/Citizen/CitizenService.aspx

facts.claim: The Income Certificate service is delivered at the Mamlatdar Office / Jan Seva Kendra.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Location : Mamlatdar Office, Jan Seva Kendra | City : Ahmedabad | PIN Code : 380027

facts.claim: Ahmedabad Mamlatdar Office publishes phone 07927551681 and mobile/helpline 18002335500 for the Income Certificate service.
facts.subject: income_certificate

facts.claim: 18002335500 is the Digital Gujarat Help Desk number for queries on online certificate applications.
facts.subject: digital_gujarat_portal
facts.evidence: For any query regarding the online application you can contact to Digital Gujarat Help Desk on 18002335500.

facts.claim: Caste Certificate requires a Resident Proof, and any one of ten listed documents is accepted as that proof.
facts.subject: caste_certificate

options: First Page Of Bank PassBook/Cancelled Cheque
Government Photo ID cards/ service photo identity card issued by PSU

facts.evidence:
Resident Proof:

- Ration Card
- True Copy of Electricity Bill.
- True Copy of Telephone Bill.
- True Copy of Election Card.
- True Copy of Passport
- First Page Of Bank PassBook/Cancelled Cheque
- Post Office Account Statement/Passbook
- Driving License
- Government Photo ID cards/ service photo identity card issued by PSU
- Water bill (not older than 3 months)

facts.claim: A light bill (electricity bill) is an accepted residence proof for the Caste Certificate.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.condition: counts only as one option within Resident Proof
facts.evidence: True Copy of Electricity Bill.

facts.claim: A ration card is an accepted residence proof for the Caste Certificate.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: Ration Card

facts.claim: A water bill is accepted as residence proof for the Caste Certificate only if it is not older than 3 months.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: Water bill (not older than 3 months)

facts.claim: Caste Certificate requires an Identity Proof, satisfied by any one of seven listed documents.
facts.subject: caste_certificate

options: True Copy Income Tax PAN Card
Government Photo ID cards/ service photo identity card issued by PSU
Any Government Document having citizen photo
Photo ID issued by Recognized Educational Institution

facts.evidence:
Identity Proof:

- True Copy of Election Card.
- True Copy Income Tax PAN Card.
- True Copy of Passport
- Driving License
- Government Photo ID cards/ service photo identity card issued by PSU
- Any Government Document having citizen photo
- Photo ID issued by Recognized Educational Institution

facts.claim: Caste Certificate requires a Caste Proof, satisfied by either a school leaving certificate or a family member's caste certificate with Pedhinamu / ration card.
facts.subject: caste_certificate

options: True Copy of School Leaving Certificate
Certificate of a caste of the family member with Pedhinamu (Family Tree issued by Talati) or Ration Card

facts.evidence:
Caste Proof:

- True Copy of School Leaving Certificate
- Certificate of a caste of the family member with Pedhinamu (Family Tree issued by Talati) or Ration Card

facts.claim: A Pedhinamu (family tree) issued by the Talati is an accepted supporting document for Caste Certificate caste proof.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: Certificate of a caste of the family member with Pedhinamu (Family Tree issued by Talati) or Ration Card

facts.claim: A school leaving certificate is an accepted caste proof for the Caste Certificate.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: True Copy of School Leaving Certificate

facts.claim: Caste Certificate requires a Relationship Proof, satisfied by a school leaving certificate, an affidavit, or the father's/uncle's/aunt's school leaving certificate.
facts.subject: caste_certificate

options: True Copy of School Leaving Certificate
An affidavit attached with the application
True Copy of School Leaving Certificate of Father/Uncle/Aunts

facts.evidence:
Relationship Proof:

- True Copy of School Leaving Certificate
- An affidavit attached with the application.
- True Copy of School Leaving Certificate of Father/Uncle/Aunts

facts.claim: An affidavit is an accepted relationship proof for the Caste Certificate.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: An affidavit attached with the application.

facts.claim: The Caste Certificate is delivered through the Jan Seva Kendra located at the respective Taluka Mamlatdar office.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: Location : Respective Taluka Mamlatdar office | City : Each Talukas

facts.claim: Digital Gujarat's ServiceDescription page is the referenced online service entry point for the Caste Certificate.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: Visit: https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/Citizen/ServiceDescription.aspx

facts.claim: Domicile Certificate requires eleven listed proofs including a Panchnamu, a Talati certificate, a police NOC and an affidavit.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate

items: No Objection Certificate of Police Station

facts.evidence:
Proofs Needed:

- Panchnamu
- Certificate of Talati.
- Applicant Answer
- Domicile by Birth (Birth Certificate)
- Proof of Parent’s Job/Business
- No Objection Certificate of Police Station
- Character Certificate
- Affidavit
- Last 10 years residence proof
- Identity Proof
- Resident Proof

facts.claim: A Certificate of Talati is required for the Domicile Certificate.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate
facts.evidence: Certificate of Talati.

facts.claim: A No Objection Certificate from the Police Station is required for the Domicile Certificate, making it an external dependency on the police.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate
facts.evidence: No Objection Certificate of Police Station

facts.claim: An affidavit is required for the Domicile Certificate.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate
facts.evidence: Affidavit

facts.claim: Domicile Certificate requires proof of residence covering the last 10 years.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate
facts.evidence: Last 10 years residence proof

facts.claim: A birth certificate establishes domicile by birth for the Domicile Certificate.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate
facts.evidence: Domicile by Birth (Birth Certificate)

facts.claim: The Domicile Certificate is delivered at the Taluka Seva Sadan / respective Taluka Mamlatdar office Jan Seva Kendra.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate
facts.evidence: Location : Respective Taluka Mamlatdar office | City : All Talukas

facts.claim: The Income Certificate (issued together with the widow certificate service) is granted by the Mamlatdar or the Taluka Development Officer.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: According to Mamlatdar / Taluka Development Officer.

facts.claim: The disposal time limit for the widow-and-income certificate service is 7 days.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Disposal time limit is 7 days.

facts.claim: The fee for the widow-and-income certificate service is Rs. 20.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Fee Rs. 20/-

facts.claim: The widow-and-income certificate application requires nine certified evidence items including income proof, an affidavit and a ration card copy.
facts.subject: income_certificate

items: Responding to the applicant's Talati face-to-face
Proof of residence (telephone bill / light bill / municipal tax bill, whatever one)
Example of age (example of a school living certificate / civil surgeon municipality or Talati)

facts.evidence:
Certified copy of the evidence

1. Applicant’s application
2. Responding to the applicant’s Talati face-to-face
3. Panchanamu
4. Proof of residence (telephone bill / light bill / municipal tax bill, whatever one)
5. Death Examples
6. Example of age (example of a school living certificate / civil surgeon municipality or Talati)
7. Income Proof
8. Affidavit (as per Appendix 4/48)
9. Copy of ration card

facts.claim: For the income certificate evidence, residence proof is satisfied by any one of a telephone bill, light bill or municipal tax bill.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Proof of residence (telephone bill / light bill / municipal tax bill, whatever one)

facts.claim: For the income certificate evidence, age proof is satisfied by a school leaving certificate or a certificate from the civil surgeon, municipality or Talati.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Example of age (example of a school living certificate / civil surgeon municipality or Talati)

facts.claim: An affidavit as per Appendix 4/48 is required for the widow-and-income certificate.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Affidavit (as per Appendix 4/48)

facts.claim: A copy of the ration card is required for the widow-and-income certificate.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Copy of ration card

facts.claim: The Talati must respond in person on the applicant's income certificate case, which is a step outside the applicant's control.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Responding to the applicant’s Talati face-to-face

facts.claim: Mahesana Mamlatdar Office publishes phone 02762236386 and email mam-mehsana[at]gujarat[dot]gov[dot]in for the income/widow certificate service.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Phone : 02762236386 | Email : mam-mehsana[at]gujarat[dot]gov[dot]in

facts.claim: Income, Domicile, SEBC, SC/ST Caste and Non-Creamy Layer certificates are all delivered through the ATVT / Jan Seva Kendra at every Taluka Mamlatdar or Panchayat office and are also available online.
facts.subject: certificates_bundle

services: Economically Backward Certificate(Other than Job/Education Purpose)
Non-Creamy layer Certificate For Gujarat Government
Non-Creamy layer Certificate For Central Government
Unreserved Economically Weaker Sections(For Job/Education Purpose)

facts.evidence:
ATVT / Jan Seva Kendra caters following citizen centric services at all Taluka Mamlatdar / Panchayat Office of Devbhumi Dwarka District.

Also these services are made available online.

facts.claim: The certificate services are physically delivered at the respective Mamlatdar or TDO (Taluka Development Officer) office in every taluka.
facts.subject: certificates_bundle
facts.evidence: Location : respective Mamlatdar / TDO Office | City : All Taluka

facts.claim: Gujarat issues two distinct Non-Creamy Layer certificates - one for Gujarat Government purposes and one for Central Government purposes.
facts.subject: non_creamy_layer_certificate

variants: Non-Creamy layer Certificate For Gujarat Government
Non-Creamy layer Certificate For Central Government

facts.evidence:
- Non-Creamy layer Certificate For Gujarat Government
- Non-Creamy layer Certificate For Central Government

facts.claim: The Economically Backward Certificate is issued specifically for purposes other than job or education, while the Unreserved EWS certificate is for job/education purposes.
facts.subject: ews_certificate
facts.condition: purpose IN [job, education] selects the EWS variant; other purposes select the Economically Backward variant
facts.evidence:
- Economically Backward Certificate(Other than Job/Education Purpose)
- Unreserved Economically Weaker Sections(For Job/Education Purpose)

facts.claim: Caste Certificate can be applied for both online on Digital Gujarat and offline at a Janseva Kendra.
facts.subject: caste_certificate
facts.evidence: Citizen can apply for this services online and offline as well. All these applications are available on comman service portal Digital Gujarat portal. Citizen can also apply at Janseva Kendra.

facts.claim: The caste-related certificate family in Gujarat consists of SEBC Certificate, SC/ST Caste Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate For Gujarat Government.
facts.subject: caste_certificate

variants: Non-Creamy Layer Certificate For Gujarat Government

facts.evidence:
- SEBC Certificate
- SC/ST Caste Certificate
- Non-Creamy Layer Certificate For Gujarat Government

facts.claim: The SEBC Certificate is issued from the Mamlatdar Office / Jan Seva Kendra and applied for on Digital Gujarat.
facts.subject: sebc_certificate
facts.evidence: Location : Mamlatdar Office, Jan Seva Kendra | City : Ahmedabad | PIN Code : 380030

facts.claim: The Non-Creamy Layer Certificate For Gujarat Government is issued from the Mamlatdar Office / Jan Seva Kendra and applied for on Digital Gujarat.
facts.subject: non_creamy_layer_certificate_gujarat
facts.evidence: Location : Mamlatdar Office, Jan Seva Kendra | City : Ahmedabad | PIN Code : 380027

facts.claim: The Jan Seva Kendra is a single-window system through which the Domicile Certificate is delivered.
facts.subject: domicile_certificate

detail.location: Janseva Kendra, Narmada Bhavan, Jail Road, Vadodara

facts.evidence: JanSeva Kendra : It is Single window system for many services. This is one of them.

facts.claim: The official Gujarat application form for the Income Certificate is Form No. 36.
facts.subject: income_certificate
facts.evidence: Income Certificate : Form No. 36

facts.claim: The State Government has approved a validity of three financial years for the income certificate from its date of issue, so it need not be re-issued for the next three financial years.
facts.subject: income_certificate

detail.context: as applied to MYSY scholarship eligibility

facts.evidence: The State Government has approved the validity of the income certificate for three financial years from the date of issue. Accordingly, a candidate who has a valid income certificate need not have to issue it again for the next three years financial years.

facts.claim: Morbi district lists Domicile Certificate and Caste Certificate under its Certificates service category alongside Birth & Death Certificate.
facts.subject: certificates_bundle
facts.evidence:
- [Birth & Death Certificate](https://morbi.nic.in/service/death-certificate/ "Birth & Death Certificate")
- [Domicile Certificate](https://morbi.nic.in/service/domicile-certificate/ "Domicile Certificate")
- [Caste Certificate](https://morbi.nic.in/service/caste-certificate/ "Caste Certificate")

notFound: The full official Digital Gujarat required-document list for the Income Certificate service. digitalgujarat.gov.in is hard-blocked from scraping (ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED on /Citizen/CitizenService.aspx, /Citizen/ServiceDescription.aspx, /Home/Index and the bare domain); URL maps returned zero links. Only the Mahesana widow+income evidence list could be verified officially.

The official statewide fee schedule per certificate. Only the Mahesana district figure of Rs. 20 for the widow-and-income certificate was verifiable; no official fee found for caste, SEBC, NCL, domicile or EWS certificates.

Statewide statutory service-delivery timelines under the Gujarat (Right of Citizens to Public Services) Act, 2013. artd.gujarat.gov.in/public-service-act.htm and kachchh.nic.in/right-of-citizen-to-public-service-act/ both failed to load. Only Mahesana's 7-day disposal limit is evidenced.

Official certificate validity period for the Caste, SEBC, Non-Creamy Layer and Domicile certificates. Only the income certificate's 3-financial-year validity was found, and only via the MYSY scheme page on myscheme.gov.in.

Official Digital Gujarat application tracking URL and grievance channel for certificate applications. Only the 18002335500 Digital Gujarat Help Desk number is evidenced; no printed tracking page or grievance URL was retrievable.

Definitive split of which office issues which certificate. District pages variously name 'Mamlatdar Office', 'Mamlatdar / Taluka Development Officer' and 'respective Mamlatdar / TDO Office' without an authoritative per-certificate mapping. No official statement found that the Collector issues any of these certificates.
Any official statement on e-Gram / Village Computer Entrepreneur as a delivery channel for these certificates.
Whether a Sarpanch report (as opposed to a Talati report or Talati-issued Pedhinamu) is officially required for any of these certificates.
Whether an Aadhaar card is a mandatory document for the income, caste or domicile certificate. It appears in no official required-document list retrieved.
